description: This file contains a static helper class for creating, converting, and handling self-signed X509 certificates, primarily for testing purposes within the Orleans security testing framework.

classes.name: TestCertificateHelper
classes.description: A static utility class providing methods to create self-signed certificates, convert certificates to and from Base64 strings, used for testing security features.

methods.name: CreateSelfSignedCertificate
methods.description: Generates a self-signed X509 certificate with specified subject name and optional extended key usage OIDs.

methods.name: ConvertToBase64
methods.description: Converts an X509Certificate2 object to a Base64-encoded string.

methods.name: ConvertFromBase64
methods.description: Creates an X509Certificate2 object from a Base64-encoded string.
